name: Gödel's Loophole

VINIT.justification: Uninitialized state before any specific amendment or executive power is defined

TANCH.justification: Closes the system by providing the ultimate interpretive boundary that contains all constitutional operations

AFWD.justification: Directed transformation pushing a bill forward toward the Article V threshold

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism checking and descending executive actions against constitutional limits

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition of supermajority votes, state certifications, and statutory steps

IMSCRIB.justification: Identity operation where the Constitution references and validates its own modification mechanism

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication branching a single proposal into two distinct constitutional pathways

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication reconstituting both ratification paths back into the exact same amended text

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch where state legislatures successfully vote and certify

EVALF.justification: Negative branch where state conventions fail to achieve supermajority

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice holding the loophole as simultaneously legally valid and politically unworkable

IFIX.justification: ROM fixation permanently recording the amendment in the National Archives

phase_3.void_description: Pre-amendment constitutional baseline, no specific executive power defined
phase_3.false_description: Ratification fails, proposal voided, status quo remains
phase_3.both_description: Legal paradox where a self-perpetuating executive power is simultaneously constitutionally permissible and politically impossible

steps.domain_action: Constitutional baseline void of specific amendment intent
Legislative proposal advances toward Article V threshold
Chains congressional supermajority requirement to ratification trigger
Forks ratification authority into dual constitutional pathways
Affirms state legislature ratification track (T-arm primary anchor)
Advances legislative voting and certification steps (T-arm secondary anchor)
Negates state convention ratification track (F-arm primary anchor)
Reverses executive overreach attempt via judicial review (F-arm secondary anchor)
Reconstitutes dual ratification outcomes into unified constitutional text
Holds legal paradox of self-amending executive power (both valid/void)
Constitution recognizes its own amendment mechanism (self-reference)
Permanently enacts the ratified amendment into the legal record
Supreme Court finality seals the constitutional boundary

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Congressional records, Supreme Court opinions, state ratification certificates
phase_5.memory_mechanism: National Archives, statutory databases, case law repositories
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Electoral cycles, congressional sessions, judicial terms

phase_6.cycle_cost: Political capital, legislative time, judicial review resources
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The legal system preserves informational integrity; ratification merely reorganizes existing constitutional data without loss or creation of new legal truth.
